item.title: Writer/Director Kleber Mendonça Filho & Best Actor Nominee Wagner Moura on Their Oscar-Nominated Thriller “The Secret Agent”
item.description: The Secret Agent could make history: if it wins Best International Feature, Brazil would become the first country in 37 years to win back-to-back. Oscar nominees writer/director Kleber Mendonça Filho & star Wagner Moura on using cinema, urban legends, and stop-motion to explore democracy's fragility. The post Writer/Director Kleber Mendonça Filho & Best Actor Nominee Wagner Moura on Their Oscar-Nominated Thriller “The Secret Agent” appeared first on Motion Picture Association.

item.title: “Predator: Badlands” Director Dan Trachtenberg Returns to Paramount With First-Look Deal
item.description: Dan Trachtenberg is going home. The director behind the Emmy-nominated "Prey" and the franchise-best "Predator: Badlands" has signed a three-year first-look deal with Paramount Pictures — the studio where he made his feature debut with '10 Cloverfield Lane' in 2016. item.title: Oscar-Nominated “Hamnet” Production Designer Fiona Crombie on Re-Inventing Shakespeare’s Home & the Globe Theater
item.description: For "Hamnet," Oscar-nominated production designer Fiona Crombie (The Favourite, Cruella) built Tudor-era sets at Elstree Studios, shipping 20 tons of oak beams from dismantled French barns to create Shakespeare's Henley House, his London attic, and the Globe Theatre.
